description: Native queue is active, yet pr-open requires current develop ancestry and agents refresh BEHIND branches repeatedly. GitHub documents that queue integration eliminates that author refresh requirement. Extend existing Make/ruleset checker, not refresh certification or a second merger. Prior decisions: native-merge-queue-activation-20260822.md amendment (ALLGREEN/60m/max5), strict-base-refresh-policy-2026-08-14.md, KEEP_IDLE. Only local ancestry handling changes; all hosted required lanes remain. New merge-group checks occur after admission, so do not require a nonexistent speculative head before opening the PR.

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a snapshot, a queued review, a skipped hook or an unbound passing check as completion
anti_patterns.instead: Bind actual evidence to the relevant PR/head/input and retain an explicit owned next action
anti_patterns.why: The observed session repeatedly lost asynchronous work or overstated evidence

preserves.behavior: KEEP_IDLE and SHADOW_ONLY remain in force for skip/shard/demotion/reduced-refresh proposals; this plan does not activate them.
Keep GitHub native merge queue as the only merger; no privileged steward, bypass actor, direct protected-branch push, or new bot credential.
Preserve required PR, merge_group, and post-merge coverage, soundness maintainer review, explicit user authority, and durable hold labels.

prior_art.concept: Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority
Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 tests/unit/scripts/test_pr_landing.py tests/unit/test_ruleset_drift.py tests/unit/workflows/test_develop_ruleset_drift.py tests/unit/test_release_infrastructure.py -q
verifications.description: Queue-aware opening preserves integration and drift protection
verifications.expected: exit 0; behavioral negative controls fail on the prior implementation

work_units.notes: Record the narrow superseding decision for local stale-base refusal under a verified native queue. Detect exact repository/target queue configuration and required-context merge_group wiring from trusted sources. Keep the existing conservative ancestry fallback if queue absent, unreadable, unsupported or misconfigured.
work_units.summary: Record queue-aware local publication policy with a conservative fallback

work_units.notes: Allow conflict-free authored-head publication/admission without a refresh solely for BEHIND when that native queue contract is verified. Preserve explicit conflict resolution, final-head review and required checks. After admission require successful actual speculative merge-group checks before claiming merge; never credit predecessor checks to that head.
work_units.summary: Avoid ancestry-only refreshes while preserving actual merge-group validation

work_units.notes: Extend the existing required ruleset drift checker and its already-required workflow wiring to validate approved merge method, grouping, response timeout, build/merge limits, no bypass actors and required merge_group contexts. Keep one expected-policy source. Report protected setting changes for operator action, do not silently repair them.
work_units.summary: Extend the existing ruleset drift check to approved queue parameters

work_units.notes: Test queue present/absent/unknown/misconfigured, base changing during local validation, real conflict, two interacting non-additive changes, ordinary feature push cancellation and soundness PR. In an authorized isolated canary prove current-base integration remains enforced without a refresh commit. Record before/after refresh count and cancelled runner time, rollback to old local guard on failure.
work_units.summary: Verify queue safety in fixtures and an authorized isolated canary
